scope.meaning: License text selection for the application plus explicitly disclosed source/build families; not binary or installer acceptance.
scope.historical_evidence: Native family decisions are those of the 2026-09-12 review; frontend decisions those of the 2026-09-12 frontend report (docs/release/license-frontend-output-2026-09-12.json). Rebound on 2026-10-20 for aidevbridge 0.2.0: changed own sources, generated permissions and the vendored russh change notices were re-hashed; @xterm/addon-web-links, the Tauri window/dpi/image modules and the vendored tslib helpers were added after a fresh frontend inventory; pageant 0.2.1 -> 0.2.4. No historical EXE, PDB or dist directory is required as a notice preparation input. Final rebuilt artifacts remain separate acceptance inputs.

selection_policy: Each component below has an explicit decision. The helper does not derive permission from historical inventory status fields or parse SPDX expressions to choose licenses.
For ordinary permissive OR alternatives, choose a complete existing MIT text when available. Retain associated copyright and source notices. Specific family reports override this routine choice.
Disclose complete permissive build/source family notices conservatively without claiming that the whole build tool is linked. The five MPL cases have individual output-boundary decisions.
Full texts are deduplicated only by exact SHA-256 bytes. Every original component, filename, notice and source association is retained.
Source repository test fixtures and other operating systems are outside this selected application payload. Future payload changes require review of this explicit selection.
Existing consolidated notice files retain their original historical progress notes. Their bytes are included for complete text/attribution, not used as current release status.

components.name: option-ext
components.reason: Both dirs-sys versions unconditionally declare extern crate option_ext, so the dependency tree alone does not exclude it. Their only OptionExt use is user_dir.contains in xdg_user_dirs.rs, whose module is gated by unix and not macOS/iOS. The Windows implementation calls known-folder APIs instead. option-ext consists of a generic trait and generic impl only, with no initializer or non-generic runtime payload. Both existing release RLIBs contain a single 324-byte COFF object whose text/data/bss raw sizes are zero; metadata is not delivered as the application. No generic instantiation is claimed absent merely because the object is empty; the caller/cfg proof is necessary.
